discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.5.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.5/cis_18.5.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.5.9 | PATCH | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds"
  when: win22cis_rule_18_5_9
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_18.5.9
    - patch
    - mss
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.10
    - NIST800-171_3.1.11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_5
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-12
  block:
    - name: "18.5.9 | PATCH | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Set ScreenSaverGracePeriod if time is 5 seconds or fewer"
      when: win22cis_screen_saver_grace_period <= 5
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Nt\CurrentVersion\Winlogon
        name: ScreenSaverGracePeriod
        data: "{{ win22cis_screen_saver_grace_period }}"
        type: string

    - name: "18.5.9 | AUDIT | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Warn if ScreenSaverGracePeriod exceeds 5 seconds"
      when: win22cis_screen_saver_grace_period > 5
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Warning!! Invalid time set for win22cis_screen_saver_grace_period. Review the notes for compliance."

    - name: "18.5.9 | AUDIT | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Set warn control ID for non-compliance"
      when: win22cis_screen_saver_grace_period > 5
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.5.9'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
